title: Live suite on master f7a26a5: a lost session_bind reply no longer parks the root prompt as Waiting/Unknown (live_root_lost_committed_replies_replay_exact_requests_once fails)
outcome: On clean master f7a26a5, `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs live` with the pinned Engram 8460234afad4 (sha256 ef3b8f9620adb6bc8e2f4198e69e01251cab3e59b16fd9fb7a25f28e5cf20078) fails tests::engram_host_adapter::root_recovery_live::live_root_lost_committed_replies_replay_exact_requests_once. For operation session_bind, the assertion at src/tests/engram_root_recovery_live.rs:702, `record.session.preview.contains("Waiting/Unknown")`, fails after a committed bind reply is dropped. The same live suite passed 13/13 on 5c6f6dd plus the w-837 change (run test-b9a1d89c-cb95-451b-911f-ebc00f66c035). So the change came in between 5c6f6dd and f7a26a5. The likely suspect is 559498f "Fix retained bind retry and isolate test home fixtures" (train 19, b24d91c); the other commits there are wording, Beads removal, an edit-fence message, a doctor-fixture teardown and a JS fixture. The full gate does not run the live stage, so no gate caught it. To decide: is the new bind-retry behaviour intended (the live test's expectation is stale and needs updating with the owner's ruling), or is it a regression (an uncertain bind must park the exact prompt as Waiting/Unknown until resumed)?
acceptance: The preserved same-pin historical comparison and actual diagnostic snapshot establish why the lost committed session_bind reply takes the same-live-host pre-evaluate/provider retained-bind retry path rather than Waiting/Unknown; the checked architectural ruling distinguishes unknown bind execution from uncertain provider delivery, with no production semantic change justified by the preview failure alone.

With pinned Engram 8460234afad4 SHA256 ef3b8f9620adb6bc8e2f4198e69e01251cab3e59b16fd9fb7a25f28e5cf20078, the corrected real lost-bind-reply witness asserts the exact retained prompt, Prepared bind/request/key and live owner proof, durable retry/head state, no evaluate/begin or provider delivery before acknowledgement/backoff/due eligibility, then drives the maintained automatic retry path without Resume or a new prompt, reconciles the identical committed bind request/key, and hands that prompt to the provider exactly once.

Lost evaluate/begin replies retain their existing explicit conservative recovery and exact-request replay assertions; exact-source restart/lost-live-proof, stale-owner and persistence-unknown controls establish no bind-only automatic release for those cases.

The pinned live suite and full maintained five-stage gate pass on the exact reviewed input, with run directories and fingerprints recorded; the independent Codex/Claude complete-input review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Corrected the test-only live session_bind expectation to prove durable acknowledged automatic exact replay without Resume; evaluate/begin remain conservative. Pinned live 13/13 and exact-input full gate 5/5 passed, independent different-vendor review pair has no Medium+, and fresh independent evaluation 63862fd682af421fbdf2bfe3af2d2ac3 passes all four criteria. Optional readability Low filed separately. Commit and integration handoff follow; no master landing, install or running-host validation claimed.
